postings.title: Applied AI Engineer
postings.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use.

What You'll Do

- Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses.

- Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization.

- Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate.

- Improve reliability, latency, and cost through prompt caching strategies, token budgets, retry logic, and observability.

- Write the tools agents use: API integrations with Pydantic validation, exercise search over local databases, structured workout submission.

What You Bring

- Strong Python skills: you've built and deployed services on large production systems.

- Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar agent frameworks.

- Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured output, evaluation.

- Comfort with async Python, HTTP APIs, and streaming protocols (SSE, webhooks).

- Experience with data validation and schema design (Pydantic, JSON Schema).

- Ability to debug across layers: from a broken LLM tool call to a misconfigured Terraform resource.

- Clear communication: you'll work directly with product, mobile, and backend engineers.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, ECR, CloudFront, S3, Cognito) or other cloud agent hosting.

- Observability and tracing tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).

- Exposure to evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-judge, automated scoring, dataset management.

- Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK).

Compensation & Benefits

We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they're building.

Base Salary $ 215,000– $ 250,000/ year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Equity Equity participation offered alongside base compensation.

Health Coverage Comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance plus tax savings accounts for all eligible employees.

Retirement 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options.

Remote-First Employment eligible to all employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required.

Wellness & Development Monthly health and fitness stipend contributing to overall wellbeing, access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend.

Flexible Time Off Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.

Future Membership Enjoy our platform for free!

Life at Future

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. postings.title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
postings.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.

You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.

What You’ll Own:

- Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.

- Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.

- Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.

- Full-Stack Delivery: Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.

- Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.

- Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.

- AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

- You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.

- You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.

- You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.

- You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.

- You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.

- You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.

- You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.

- You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.

Working Style

- You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.

- You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.

- You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.

- You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.

- You balance growth urgency with product quality and member trust.

Nice to Have

- Experience at a consumer subscription, marketplace, or membership product where acquisition and activation were core to the business.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.

- Experience with paid acquisition landing systems, attribution, SEO/organic surfaces, lifecycle messaging, or referral loops.

- Experience building or evolving experimentation platforms, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation at scale.

- Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.

- Prior work on expert tooling, internal operator workflows, or coach-facing surfaces that support member outcomes.

postings.title: Health Coach
postings.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.
Who We Are

Future pairs each member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started in fitness, and we're now going further: a coaching-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and leverages real clinical data to build precise, custom member protocols. Our offering is continuing to evolve and we're looking for coaches who want to help shape it.

About the Role

Role Type: 1099 (independent contractor) Full-time

As a Health Coach, you'll own a caseload of members and guide each of them from their first day through their progress milestones. This is a partner role, not a prescriber role: you draw out what a member actually wants, meet them where they are, and help them build habits that last across nutrition, movement, sleep, and stress. You'll coach through a mix of virtual face-to-face sessions and day-to-day messaging, and you'll use each member's data to make your guidance specific and personal. The members we serve expect high-touch, polished care, with the coach at the center of their experience. 

What you'll do

- Own your members' experience end to end. Guide a caseload of members from onboarding through their 90-day milestone and beyond, and keep every one of them feeling individually known.

- Coach live and asynchronously. Run virtual kickoff and check-in sessions, and support members between sessions over messaging that stays warm, timely, and clear.

- Build personalized, data-informed plans. With the support of AI tooling, translate each member's goals and data into a plan across fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, and adjust it as their life and results change. 

- Coach the person, not just the plan. Use motivational interviewing and reflective listening to help members find their own reasons for change and choose their own next step, rather than handing them a prescription.

- Make the data useful. Under the guidance of Future’s Clinical Team, contextualize body composition scans, bloodwork and GLP-1 considerations within your scope, and turn them into everyday actions a member can take.

- Make progress visible. Track progress against goals your members helped set, and celebrate the behavior and consistency wins, not just the number on a scan.

- Help build. Bring what you learn from members back to the team, and help us shape a program that's ever growing and evolving. 

Who you are

- Empathetic. You lead with care and meet people where they are, whether it's a member having a hard week or a teammate under pressure.

- Independent, and collaborative. You can run your caseload at a high level without hand-holding, and you still genuinely enjoy working alongside your teammates.

- An active part of the community. Even though we're a virtual company, you show up: you join calls, contribute to projects, and share honest feedback that makes the team better.

- Proactive. You chase down answers, follow up, and take initiative instead of waiting to be told.

- Tech-savvy. You pick up new tools quickly and are comfortable working across apps, data, and platforms all day.

What you'll need

Required (non-negotiable)

- NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach) — full board certification through the National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching is required. This is our core standard for behavior-change theory, motivational interviewing, reflective listening, and coaching scope of practice.

- An associate's degree or higher (or an equivalent, experience-based path to your coaching certification).

- 2+ years of client-facing coaching or training experience. Enough that you can run a member session on day one, without a ramp.

- Proven high-volume caseload management. You've personally carried a large book of clients at once and kept each of them feeling individually known.

- Comfort working with a diverse member population. You adapt your style to meet members of different ages, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and health starting points, and every one of them feels respected and understood.

- Strong written communication. Much of your coaching happens over messaging, so you're warm, clear, and personable on the page while staying professional.

- Strong verbal communication and presence. You also coach face-to-face over video, and you bring confidence, thoughtfulness and professionalism into every session.

- Comfortable synthesizing health data. You keep up with current health trends and have a track record of coaching clients across nutrition apps and wearable devices, bringing their data together into a single comprehensive plan.

Strong plus (not required)

- Additional coaching credentials layered on top of NBC-HWC, such as ACE Health Coach, Precision Nutrition L1, or NASM Behavior Change Specialist.

- A personal-training or strength credential (CSCS; NASM, ACE, or ACSM CPT; or similar).

- A nutrition-coaching certification such as Precision Nutrition.

- An advanced degree in exercise science, physiology, kinesiology, or a related field.

- Clinical collaboration in functional or integrative medicine. You've worked alongside or under registered dietitians, nurse practitioners, or physicians.

- Experience with luxury clientele. You've served high-end members in concierge medicine, a premium gym, or a private club, and you carry that polish into every interaction.

- A distinct coaching specialty such as performance, postpartum, pelvic-floor, or eating-disorder-informed coaching, that adds range to our team.

- Startup experience, or time spent in a fast-changing, still-being-built environment.

What we offer

Engagement Type

- This is an 1099 independent contractor engagement, not employment. Contractors are engaged through a written services agreement, are responsible for their own taxes, and are not eligible for Future employee benefits.

- Remote (residence in approved state) We are currently ONLY hiring in AZ, FL, GA, NC, OH, SC, TN, TX, UT.

Compensation

- The compensation range for this engagement is $30–$40 per hour, based on experience and credentials.

Future is an equal opportunity organization. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable law, including the California Fair Chance Act.

Life at Future

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.

postings.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.
About the Role

Role Type: 1099 (independent contractor)

Future pairs every member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started by reinventing personal training. Now we're building a coaching-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, backed by real clinical data like bloodwork and body composition scans.

We're hiring a Registered Dietitian to coach members 1:1 on nutrition. You'll meet with members virtually, get to know their goals and their data, and build nutrition plans and meal plans that fit how they actually live. Then you'll partner with their health coach, adjusting as their results and their lives change.

This is a hands-on role on a small, growing team. You'll work alongside Future's coaching team and clinical team, and execute on what great nutrition coaching looks like at Future.

What You'll Own

- 1:1 Nutrition Coaching: Run virtual sessions with your members, from first consult through ongoing check-ins, and keep each one feeling individually known. This will be in partnership with their health coach.

- Personalized Nutrition Planning: Build nutrition plans, which may include meal plans and nutrition strategies that fit real life: travel, work dinners, family schedules, and training.

- Data Interpretation: Use health history, bloodwork, body composition scans, food logs, CGM, and wearable data to shape each member's plan, and explain what it means in plain language.

- GLP-1 & Body Composition Support: Guide members on GLP-1 medications or working on body composition, including protein, muscle preservation, and fueling.

- Behavior Change: Use motivational interviewing to help members find their own reasons to change and build habits that last.

- Care Coordination: Partner with health coaches to support members, and MD when necessary. Flag what needs a clinician, and refer out when a member needs a different level of care.

- AI-Assisted Coaching: Use Future's AI tools to move faster, and apply your judgment before anything reaches a member.

Who You Are

Experience & Background

- Active RD/RDN credential with the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR), plus state licensure where required. Licenses in multiple states preferred.

- 5+ years as a practicing RD, with 3+ in 1:1 client counseling: outpatient, private practice, telehealth, or concierge medicine.

- You've managed an ongoing caseload of 25+ 1:1 clients over months, not just one-time consults.

- You've built meal plans and nutrition strategies for individual clients and seen them through.

- You're skilled in motivational interviewing or another client-centered behavior change counseling methods.

- You're confident interpreting labs and body composition results, then creating nutrition plans around them.

- Strong preference for experience with integrative and/or functional nutrition.

- You're comfortable on video and strong in writing.

- You use AI tools in your work, like research, plan drafting, or documentation, and you know how to check their output before it reaches a client.

Domain Passion

You care about preventive health, performance, and longevity. This isn't a box you're checking. You believe food is one of the most powerful levers a person has, and you've seen what happens when people get advice that fits their real life instead of a generic plan. You stay current on research in metabolic health, GLP-1 care, body composition, and sports nutrition, and you can tell the evidence from the hype.

Working Style

- Member-Led. You lead with curiosity and meet people where they are.

- Plain-language translator. You make lab results and science make sense to busy people.

- Independent. You run your caseload without hand-holding and take initiative.

- Polished. Members with high expectations trust you quickly.

Nice to Have

- A specialty credential: IFNCP, CSSD, CSOWM, CDCES, or functional nutrition training.

- GLP-1 or CGM experience.

- Experience in a team-based care model at a telehealth, virtual weight-care, or concierge or longevity company.

- Startup experience.

What Success Looks Like

- Members follow plans they helped build and stay engaged month over month.

- Members see measurable progress in their labs, body composition, and the goals they care about.

- Every member feels individually known.

postings.title: Staff Product Manager
postings.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the core marketplace experience. We’re rethinking things from the ground up—you won’t be inheriting a roadmap, a backlog, or a set of conventions. You’ll be building the product from the ground up alongside the CPTO.

This role requires someone who thinks in systems. A marketplace is not a single product—it’s an ecosystem. You’ll need to hold the consumer experience, the practitioner experience, the matching logic, the trust and safety layer, the business model, and the growth loops in your head simultaneously, and make smart tradeoffs between them every day.

You will report directly to the CPTO and work alongside a small, senior engineering team. There are no layers between you and the work, and no layers between you and the decisions that shape the company.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

Product Strategy & Vision

- Define the product vision and strategy for the marketplace, grounded in deep user understanding, competitive analysis, and a clear-eyed view of the business model.

- Own the roadmap end-to-end. Decide what to build, what to kill, and what to sequence—with conviction, not consensus.

- Develop and maintain a strong point of view on where the wellness and longevity market is heading and how our product should evolve to lead, not follow.

- TRUE 0→1 product thinking: identify the fastest and cheapest ways to validate core assumptions before committing significant engineering investment.

Marketplace Systems Thinking

- Design and optimize both sides of the marketplace: the consumer journey (discovery → trust → booking → retention) and the practitioner journey (onboarding → activation → growth → advocacy).

- Develop frameworks for marketplace health: supply/demand balance, liquidity metrics, matching quality, and network effects.

- Own the cold-start playbook. Figure out how to bootstrap supply and demand in new verticals and geographies.

- Think critically about marketplace trust and safety—credential verification, reviews, dispute resolution—as a product surface, not an afterthought.

Execution & Shipping

- Partner with engineering and design to ship continuously. Write clear, opinionated specs. Run structured discovery. Make scope decisions that keep velocity high.

- Instrument everything. Define success metrics for every feature. Run experiments. Kill things that aren’t working.

- Balance competing priorities across consumer, practitioner, and platform workstreams while maintaining a clear view of the overall system.

Business & Growth

- Own the business logic of the marketplace: pricing models, take rates, subscription tiers, transaction economics.

- Partner with growth and marketing on acquisition loops, activation funnels, and retention strategies for both sides of the marketplace.

- Use data to identify the highest-leverage opportunities. Build the instrumentation and dashboards needed to operate with clarity.

AI as a Force Multiplier

- AI should be part of your daily operating system as a product manager.

- Research synthesis: distilling user interviews, market data, and competitive intel at speed.

- Spec and strategy drafting: using AI to accelerate writing, then applying your judgment to sharpen it.

- Data analysis: querying, visualizing, and interpreting data with AI assistance.

- Prototyping: rapidly generating UI concepts, user flows, and copy variations.

- Workflow automation: building personal and team workflows that eliminate toil.

- Bring a perspective on how AI should be woven into the product itself—personalized recommendations, intelligent matching, automated practitioner tools.

- Raise the AI fluency bar for the entire team. Share what’s working. Push others to adopt.

WHO YOU ARE:

Experience & Background

- 7+ years of product management experience, with significant time on marketplace, platform, or multi-sided products.

- You’ve been a startup founder, a founding PM, or an early employee who built 0→1 products with limited resources. You know what it’s like to ship when there’s no playbook, no established process, and no safety net.

- You’ve operated at the Senior, Staff, or Principal level—or you’ve functioned at that altitude regardless of your title (common for founders and early-stage operators).

- Proven ability to ship products that drive measurable business outcomes, not just features.

Domain Passion

You are passionate about wellness, longevity, and preventive health. This isn’t a box you’re checking—you have a personal connection to this space. Maybe you’ve seen the healthcare system fail someone you love. Maybe you’ve gone deep on your own health optimization. Maybe you’ve worked in healthtech and know firsthand how much better it could be.

You stay current on trends in functional medicine, longevity research, consumer health, and the evolving practitioner landscape.

Working Style

- Exceptional product taste. You see what’s working, what’s not, and what’s missing—and you care about the details.

- Clear, precise communicator—in writing, in specs, in conversation, and in a room with engineers.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and pace. You don’t need permission to act. You don’t wait for perfect information.

- Strong analytical chops. You pull your own data, run your own analyses, and let evidence shape your decisions.

- Low ego, high ownership. You do what needs to be done—whether that’s writing a spec, responding to a user complaint, or fixing a broken onboarding email.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Direct experience in health, wellness, longevity, or consumer health—and an understanding of the regulatory, trust, and compliance dynamics of the space.

- Experience building or scaling a marketplace through cold-start, supply/demand balancing, and network effects.

- Experience building AI-native products (not just AI features bolted onto existing workflows).

- Technical depth—you can read code, write SQL, or prototype in no-code/low-code tools.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they’re building. We hire individuals who raise the bar, and we compensate accordingly — with competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits designed to support your life and growth.

- Base Compensation: $220,000-280,000 The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

- Equity: Meaningful early-stage equity package with standard 4-year vesting and 1-year cliff.

- Health Coverage: All employees who meet the eligibility requirements receive Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus life and disability coverage

- Retirement: 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options

- Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the continental U.S. We’re a distributed team that values async communication, deep focus time, and intentional in-person gatherings.

- Home Office Support: Stipend to set up your workspace and monthly support for internet or coworking

- Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support

- Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work

- Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft

Life at Future

We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.
